image_description: A close-up shot of two small hamsters against a bright blue background. The foreground subject is a grey and white hamster, viewed from the rear/side, showing dense fur and a rounded body. The background subject is a grey hamster facing right, with visible head features including a dark eye, rounded ear, and short snout. One tiny pink foot is visible on the background hamster.
